title: Mighty Mouse: ESP32-Powered 4WD Combat Robot
description: Designed a 4WD metal-chassis combat robot with a high-RPM spinner weapon, dual ESP32 ESP-NOW control, LiPo power distribution, motor drivers, and a dedicated ESC.

title: IIoT-Based Predictive Maintenance System
description: Simulated an IIoT predictive maintenance system with a virtual ESP32 edge device and MQTT telemetry pipeline to visualize temperature and voltage degradation.

title: IoT-Based Environmental Monitoring System
description: Simulated an ESP32 multi-sensor system using DHT22, MQ-135, and LDR sensors with calibration, ADC processing, moving-average filtering, and ThingSpeak dashboards.

title: PMSG Based Gearless Variable Speed Wind Turbine
description: Simulated a gearless variable-speed wind turbine with a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator and back-to-back converter for stable power output.

title: Solar Power Generation for Home
description: Simulated a residential solar energy system with photovoltaic input, power conversion, PWM control, feedback loops, and real-time performance monitoring.

title: AI-Based Rockfall Prediction and Alert System
description: Built a predictive AI dashboard that analyzes geological and environmental data to forecast rockfall events and provide mine planners with live risk maps.

title: Quiz App
description: Developed a social quiz platform where users can create and participate in quizzes, with private quizzes, authentication, photo uploads, follows, likes, and dynamic feeds.

title: Online Voting System
description: Built a responsive polling website with user registration, login, poll management, and voting based on selected interests.
